name: session-ops
description: Multi-repo operations layer for Claude Code, companion to session-flow. A 5-skill set covering the ops loop for a one-person software factory: registry + private workspace init, per-repo enrollment into a hardened two-workflow GitHub Actions clock (event-driven issue triage + slow daily sweep), raw-idea capture into a per-unit inbox, a deterministic multi-repo portfolio with staleness/quota/escalation columns, and draft-only release announcements. v1 triages and drafts; it never implements or publishes.
